body.message:
Your reservation is confirmed until May 2nd. Kindly note that if you choose to check out tomorrow, the remaining unused days will not be refunded, as the booking is under a non-refundable policy.

After check-out, the security deposit will be refunded within 14 working days; however, we will do our best to process it sooner, ideally within 7 working days.

You may leave the access cards inside the apartment and share a photo with us for confirmation
